; File: X_Coord_F.ANA ; Created: Tue, Sep 3 1991, 17:43:09 ; Author: LOFDAHL@royacs.astro.su.se ; Return 2D matrix with x coordinates relative to origin at (r,r). ; Coordinate is unity at r_c ; Rewrite this to use IndGen of array with second argument to give ; x- or y- (0 or 1, resp.) coordinates. FUNCTION red_horizontal_coordinate,r,r_c,xOffset=xOffset x = dindgen(2*r,2*r) mod (2*r) ; 2D index in x-direction. x = x - r if n_elements(xOffset) ne 0 then x = x - xOffset x = x / float(r_c) Return, x END; X_Coord
